name: T3tris Finance WBTC vault

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: One bare EOA is the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holder on this WBTC vault and also holds 46 of its 47 narrower roles, with no Safe and no timelock among any role holder.
narrative.detail: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE was granted once, at deployment, and never revoked (a log replay on one RPC, hasRole confirmed on two). The 47th narrower role belongs to a second bare EOA and is administered by itself, so the DEFAULT_ADMIN key cannot revoke it. T3tris publishes no vault source, so what any role can do is not read from source.

steps.what: getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0) on the contract (AccessControl, enumerable): the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (78 at the read)

curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'

curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xd5c6c79692715145098a65d1eb1f2a10c524f8e8","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'

curl -s -X POST https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","0x5210ddc"]}'

cheapest_fix.what: admin power taken away from a bare key
